passage.label: When comes greatest Overwhelming Calamity; Day man remember strove; Hellfire exposed those see; transgressed preferred life world; Indeed Hellfire refuge; feared position Lord prevented soul unlawful inclination; Indeed Paradise refuge; ask Muhammad Hour when arrival; what position should mention it; Lord finality; only warner those fear it; Day see it though not remained except afternoon morning thereof

arabicExcerpts.text: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفۡسَ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ
كَأَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَهَا لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوۡ ضُحَىٰهَا

mainSubject.label: When the greatest Overwhelming Calamity arrives, man will remember what he strove for and Hellfire will be exposed for all who see; the transgressor who preferred worldly life finds Hellfire as his refuge while the one who feared his Lord's position and restrained his soul from unlawful inclination finds Paradise as his refuge; the Hour's timing asked of the Prophet who has no standing to declare it since its finality rests with his Lord, his role limited to warning those who fear it; on the Day they see it they will feel as though they had remained in the world only an afternoon or a morning

subordinateSubjects.label: Man remembering what he strove for on that Day
Hellfire exposed for all who see
The transgressor identified by his preference for worldly life
The one who feared his Lord's position and restrained his soul from inclination
They ask you about the Hour: when is its arrival
In what position are you that you should mention it
To your Lord is its finality
You are only a warner for those who fear it
On the Day they see it, the reckoning becomes real
As though they had remained in the world only an afternoon or a morning thereof

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the sudden-alertness-after-one-shout statement (14) before the Musa narrative opens (15); P2 ends with the warning-for-the-God-fearing conclusion (26) before the creation-comparison argument begins (27); P3 runs through the heaven-earth-mountain provision catalogue (27-33); P4 covers the Overwhelming Calamity, the two-refuge outcomes, the Hour-timing question and the closing time-compression simile (34-46).
